Name: Dungeon Merchants
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
By default, this mod causes the dwarf to spawn randomly (5% chance) on mine floors, and the desert merchant to spawn randomly (5% chance) on skull cavern floors.

You can change the chance, set min and max floors, and set floor multiples for each in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or the config file.

You can set specific spawn floors for each by editing the config file.

Floor multiples means they will spawn on floors divisible by that number (1 = spawns on every floor).


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Implements a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] interface to change config settings in-game.

Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6338]Mod Updater[/url]﻿ for automatic updates.

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
